title: Seat a gift-box lid squarely
instruction: Put the lid fully onto the gift box, level and square. Keep the gift inside and leave the box where it is. Let go when it is seated.
context: Closing a gift box is a familiar precision placement: a skewed skirt catches the rim and a hard push moves the packed box. This task uses an explicitly reproducible printable slip-over pair, with an open base and a hollow lid. It does not claim to require both arms.
setup: Bimanual YAM station, fixed layout and object_jitter=0. Coordinates are metres: x forward from the midpoint between arm bases, y to the robot's left, z above the table. The burgundy base is the supplied original base.stl/base.usda design: solid PLA, outside 100 x 66 x 40 mm, cavity 96 x 62 x 38 mm, floor and walls 2 mm, model-derived mass 46.90176 g, centred at (0.24, -0.10), open side up. The pale lid is the supplied lid.stl/lid.usda design: solid PLA, outside 108 x 74 x 28 mm, inside 104 x 70 x 26 mm, top and skirt 2 mm, model-derived mass 42.77504 g, centred at (0.20, -0.26), top up and skirt down. Both long axes follow x and both are movable compound rigid bodies with one convex collider per panel. Centred design clearance is 2 mm on each of the four sides. A plain oak gift block, 60 x 38 x 20 mm and 31.92 g at assumed density 700 kg/m^3, lies flat inside the base with the same horizontal centre. Base and lid spawn 1 mm above the table; the gift spawns 1 mm above the initial base floor. Print both box parts in PLA at 100 percent infill, 0.2 mm layers and 0.4 mm nozzle, allowing +/-0.2 mm linear dimension error; print the lid top-down, then invert for setup. Dimensions come from design files and have not been physically measured. No commercial cardboard-box equivalence is claimed.
scoring: Final-state highest tier, never summed. All automatic credit requires a valid initial layout, no latched violation, still objects, both complete grippers at least 30 mm from the objects, and readable gripper states. 0.25: upright lid skirt rests at the base rim within 2 mm, centre offset <=25 mm, tilt <=5 degrees. 0.5: upright skirt is at least 10 mm below the rim and no deeper than nominal seating plus 1.5 mm, centre offset <=8 mm, tilt <=10 degrees. 0.75: lid top within 1.5 mm of the current base rim plus the 2 mm top panel, centre offset <=1 mm, relative yaw <=3 degrees and tilt <=2 degrees. Full success additionally requires centre offset <=0.5 mm, relative yaw <=1.5 degrees and tilt <=1 degree, held continuously for 1 s by the framework; score() itself never returns 1.0. The base must finish within 3 mm of its table-resting height and within 2 degrees of upright. More than 20 mm of base displacement, base/lid toppling beyond 15/30 degrees, a box more than 10 mm below the table, any object speed above 0.75 m/s, the gift leaving the base interior (1 mm numerical margin), an unexplained >100 mm one-step jump, or invalid initial/state data is latched to zero. Only a >100 mm step returning the complete nominal layout resets the episode. Stillness uses the last ten positions (every sample within 2 mm) and orientations (0.5 degrees); before filling the window it uses speed <=10 mm/s and spin <=0.10 rad/s. In video review mode, object-only partial credit is capped at 0.75 and full success is disabled pending manual release review.
run_limit: 800 control steps (40 seconds at 20 Hz); nominal scripted plan 470 intervals plus settling hold; GPU runtime pending.
fidelity: Original printable PLA geometry, not a cardboard material model. Both parts have actual cavities, five primitive convex colliders, and a mass/centre of mass integrated from a watertight STL at assumed solid PLA density 1240 kg/m^3. No flex, dents, adhesion, paper wrapping, trapped-air suction, manufacturing warp or robot tracking error is modelled. Dimensions and per-side clearance are design values, not physical measurements. CPU kinematic feasibility passed; rigid-body demo, grip stability, solver contact precision and the delayed public-API gripper reader remain unverified on GPU. Automatic pose and hand clearance establish a conservative geometric end condition, not a force/contact measurement. Inherited framework contact offset 5 mm, rest offset zero and static/dynamic friction 1.2/1.0 are uncalibrated for the 2 mm PLA side clearances.
reset_notes: Return the open base and top-up lid to the stated centres and yaw; lay the wooden gift flat inside the base. Inspect actual printed dimensions and all four side clearances before real trials; no sample has been measured yet. Replace a warped or damaged pair. A new episode clears latched violations only on a single-step position change greater than 100 mm while the complete layout returns to nominal; slowly rearranging objects does not clear history.
